name: agent-council
description: Stop manually switching AI models. Send each task to the right model tier and add independent review when the work is risky.

interface.shortDescription: Match each task to the right AI model.
interface.longDescription: Stop using an expensive model for every easy step, or burning time on a cheaper model that cannot finish a hard one. Agent Council lets your Codex or Claude Code chat send each subtask to the model tier that fits it. Straightforward work stays lightweight. Difficult or risky work can escalate to stronger models, independent review, and evidence checks. It works on its own and does not require another plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Council to choose the right model tier for each part of this task, escalating only when complexity or risk warrants it.
